_comment: Measured by scripts/instant_tier_eval.ts running apps/mobile/src/live/instantTier.ts over the real corpus audio (2 s loudest window per clip, 16 kHz). RAVDESS is the cross-corpus number: the model was fitted on CREMA-D only and has never seen a RAVDESS actor, room or script. Regenerate with `npx tsx scripts/instant_tier_eval.ts`.

withinCorpus.note: trained on this corpus; not a generalisation claim

latency.note: node on the dev Mac; a phone JS engine is slower, budget is 40 ms
